system.description: In cities, there is a neverending but hidden war waged by the lav. The arms used in this war are just as unfamiliar to most citizens of the Empire as the war itself - a fact that contributes to their deadliness. Damage Rating: 3 Critical Rating: 2 Group: Exotic Encumbrance: 2 Traits: Concealable, Pierce 1 An attack with this weapon that causes damage and gets a [Dc] result gains: suffer 1 fatigue to make a basic melee attack with this weapon.
